        ### Question
        All of the following side effects are produced by Cisplatin except

CHAIN: "Cisplatin" -> "accumulates in renal tubular cells" -> "Nephrotoxicity" -> 95%

response.enhanced_information: Cisplatin is known to cause Ototoxicity and Nephrotoxicity due to its effects on cochlear hair cells and renal tubular cells, respectively. It is also associated with the Coasting effect, where neurotoxic symptoms can persist after treatment. However, Pulmonary Fibrosis is not a recognized side effect of Cisplatin, as evidence linking it to lung tissue damage is broad and non-specific.
